pdpa.description: We collect and process your personal data for recruitment purposes under applicable data protection laws (PDPA Thailand / Decree 13 Vietnam / UU PDP Indonesia). Your data will be retained for 2 years or until consent is withdrawn.

pdpa.settings_desc: Export or delete your personal data. View consent history.
pdpa.export_desc: Download a complete copy of your personal data in JSON format. This includes your profile, applications, documents, and consent records.
pdpa.delete_desc: Anonymize your personal data. PII fields will be replaced with anonymized values. Non-PII business records (application history, audit logs) will be retained for operational continuity.
pdpa.delete_warning: This action is irreversible. Your name, email, phone, and other personal identifiers will be permanently anonymized.
pdpa.delete_confirm_message: This will permanently anonymize your personal data. Your name, email, phone and other PII will be replaced with anonymized values. This action cannot be undone.

landing.hero_title: HR work that used to take all day now takes minutes
landing.hero_subtitle: AdminMate AI helps SEA SMEs hire faster, onboard smarter, and stay compliant — with an AI assistant built for HR teams.
landing.pain_title: HR in SEA shouldn't feel this hard
landing.pain_subtitle: Small HR teams juggle spreadsheets, chat apps, paper forms, and guesswork. AdminMate AI replaces the chaos with one focused platform.
landing.pain1_desc: Posting jobs, screening CVs, scheduling interviews, chasing documents — all by hand.
landing.pain2_desc: Offers, contracts, and onboarding forms spread across email, LINE, and Google Drive.
landing.pain3_desc: PDPA, labor law, data residency — hard to track when you're a 5-person HR team.
landing.value_title: One platform for the full HR lifecycle
landing.value_subtitle: From the first job post to the last compliance check — AdminMate AI covers every step.
landing.mod_recruitment_desc: Post jobs, screen CVs with AI, manage your pipeline.
landing.mod_onboarding_desc: Track tasks, send documents, guide new hires.
landing.mod_documents_desc: Upload, send for e-signature, track status.
landing.mod_chat_desc: Ask Mate AI for job drafts, compliance answers, reports.
landing.workflows_title: Built for how HR actually works
landing.flow1_desc: AI generates job descriptions from your requirements. Publish to your career page instantly.
landing.flow2_desc: AI scores resumes against your criteria. Drag candidates through your custom pipeline stages.
landing.flow3_desc: Book interviews, collect structured feedback, and make offers — all in one flow.
landing.flow4_desc: Track onboarding tasks, send documents for e-signature, and maintain PDPA consent records.
landing.security_subtitle: AdminMate AI is built with privacy and compliance at its core.
landing.trust1_desc: Built-in consent banners, purpose tracking, and consent history for Thai PDPA compliance.
landing.trust2_desc: Export your data or request account deletion at any time from Privacy & Data settings.
landing.trust3_desc: Supabase-hosted with regional data residency options. You control access with role-based permissions.
landing.audience_title: Built for growing HR teams in Southeast Asia
landing.aud1_desc: Lean teams that need one platform instead of five tools.
landing.aud2_desc: Companies operating across Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia.
landing.aud3_desc: Teams moving from spreadsheets and chat apps to their first HR platform.
landing.cta_subtitle: Start free. No credit card required. Set up in minutes.
landing.footer_disclaimer: AdminMate AI is a product for HR workflow management. It does not provide legal, tax, or compliance advice. Consult qualified professionals for regulatory guidance.

pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more. No hidden fees.
pricing.plan_free_desc: For solo HR evaluating the platform
pricing.plan_growth_desc: For SMEs with active hiring needs
pricing.plan_pro_desc: For growing companies with complex needs
pricing.faq1_q: Can I try before I buy?
pricing.faq1_a: Yes. The Free tier lets you explore the platform with no time limit. Upgrade when you need more features or higher limits.
pricing.faq2_a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade from Settings at any time. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
pricing.faq3_q: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing.faq3_a: We accept major credit and debit cards through Stripe. Bank transfer options may be available for annual plans.
pricing.faq4_q: Is there a discount for annual billing?
pricing.faq4_a: Yes. Annual billing saves approximately 2 months compared to monthly billing — roughly 17% off.
pricing.cta_subtitle: Create your free account in minutes. No credit card required.
